title: Appraisal Order Refunds by Cancellation Stage
content:
Appraisal Order refunds follow the stage the order had reached when it was cancelled, read from its status at cancellation.

### Refunds by cancellation stage

| Status at cancellation | What is refunded | Refund reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Ordered (no appraiser assigned) | Every charge, in full | cancelled before assignment |
| Assigned or on hold (no inspection yet) | The appraisal fee less the report type's cancellation fee after assignment, which is retained; every other charge not yet earned (rush, surcharges, rent schedule) in full | cancelled before inspection |
| After inspection | The report type's cancellation share after inspection is retained out of the appraisal fee — at 100 percent, no appraisal fee is refunded; unearned rush and add-on charges are refunded | — |

The appraisal fee refunded after assignment is the report type's appraisal fee less its cancellation fee after assignment. A retained cancellation fee is not a separate charge; it is the part of the appraisal fee not refunded.

### Refunds regardless of stage
- Any charge collected before intent to proceed is refunded in full (reason: charged before intent to proceed).
- Any charge on a higher-priced mortgage loan flip second appraisal is refunded in full (reason: HPML second appraisal not chargeable).

### How a refund is made
A refund disposes only of a charge entry that has not already been refunded; this is read from Larkspur's record of the order's fee entries, by the charge entry the refund names. Refunds go to the original payment method within the report type's refund period in business days and name the charge entry they return.

### Retired clause
"When the order was delivered later than its due date after the borrower paid for rush, the rush fee is refunded in full (rush deadline missed) even though the report was completed." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.

### Worked example (hypothetical)
A hypothetical order of the Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) with a 650.00 appraisal fee and a 150.00 rush fee is cancelled while assigned. The appraisal fee refund is 650.00 less the 100.00 cancellation fee after assignment, that is 550.00; the 150.00 rush fee, not yet earned, is refunded in full; the 100.00 retained is the part of the appraisal fee not refunded, not a new charge.

superseded_clauses: When the order was delivered later than its due_date after the borrower paid for rush, the rush_fee is refunded in full (rush_deadline_missed) even though the report was completed.
